name: mroffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @mroffice/i18n && npm run test -w @mroffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @mroffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @mroffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @mroffice/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @mroffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @mroffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @mroffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @mroffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @mroffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @mroffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @mroffice/project-store && npm run test -w @mroffice/docs && npm run test -w @mroffice/sheets && npm run test -w @mroffice/shell && npm run test -w @mroffice/slides && npm run test -w @mroffice/pdf && npm run test -w @mroffice/markdown
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @mroffice/markdown
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @mroffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @mroffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @mroffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @mroffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @mroffice/markdown" "node tools/dev-shell.mjs"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @mroffice/docs && npm run build -w @mroffice/sheets && npm run build -w @mroffice/slides && npm run build -w @mroffice/pdf && npm run build -w @mroffice/markdown && npm run build -w @mroffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @mroffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @mroffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @mroffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @mroffice/shell
